title: Tokenizer asset identity
content: The exact tokenizer asset is assets/tokenizers/qwen2/tokenizer.json. Load it once at process startup and record its SHA256 fingerprint so token counts and sparse token IDs remain reproducible.

title: Mandatory scope filtering
content: Every document query must send a server-side knowledge_scope filter. Returned payloads are checked again, and a cross-scope point is a hard integrity failure rather than a soft retrieval warning.

title: Dense embedding baseline
content: The Dense baseline uses the local bge-m3 model to create 1024-dimensional vectors and compares them with Cosine distance. It is measured before adding Sparse, Hybrid, or Reranker stages.

title: Field-aware BM25 weights
content: Field-aware Sparse retrieval weights title 3.0, heading path 2.0, source_ref 1.5, and body or code 1.0. BM25 parameters are k1=1.2 and b=0.75, while Qdrant applies collection-level IDF.

title: Weighted RRF formula
content: Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion adds dense_weight divided by 60 plus dense_rank and sparse_weight divided by 60 plus sparse_rank. Raw Dense and Sparse scores are not added because their scales are not comparable.

title: FuseRRF API
content: func FuseRRF(dense, sparse []Candidate, weights FusionWeights, rankConstant int) ([]Candidate, error) merges candidates by stable chunk identity and records each leg contribution.

title: Strict Reranker contract
content: A Reranker response must contain every input candidate ID exactly once with a finite relevance score. Missing, duplicate, or invented IDs invalidate the response and preserve the original RRF order with a warning.

title: Document and heading diversity
content: After reranking, deterministic diversity keeps at most three chunks from one document and at most two chunks from one heading path. Skipped candidates retain an explicit diagnostic reason.

title: Isotonic calibration with PAVA
content: Score calibration uses deterministic isotonic regression with the pool adjacent violators algorithm, abbreviated PAVA. It fits only the train split and reports Brier score and expected calibration error on validation.

title: Production Golden Dataset v1
content: The production-style Golden Dataset v1 contains 40 reviewed cases: 24 train and 16 validation. It covers exact, code, semantic, mixed, and negative queries and binds corpus and cases with SHA256 checksums.

title: Verified snapshot alias
content: A complete physical Qdrant snapshot is verified before the stable alias is activated. Rollback points the alias to an earlier verified collection; the publication workflow never needs to delete a physical collection.

title: RAG-2048 vector identity error
content: Error code RAG-2048 means the configured embedding model, vector dimension, tokenizer fingerprint, or dataset identity does not match the active retrieval collection. Rebuild an isolated snapshot instead of coercing incompatible data.

title: Backup restoration drill
content: Run a restoration drill every quarter. A backup is not considered usable until a clean environment restores it and the manifest, row counts, and application smoke tests all pass.

title: OPS-503 deployment lock
content: Error code OPS-503 indicates that another deployment owns the promotion lock. Inspect the active release job and lease expiry; do not delete the lock row while the owner is healthy.

title: Liveness and readiness
content: Liveness answers whether the process should be restarted. Readiness answers whether it can safely receive traffic, including required database connectivity and completed startup migrations.

title: Release rollback
content: Rollback promotes the last verified release artifact and restores its compatible configuration. Database changes must be backward compatible because application rollback does not reverse destructive migrations.

title: Secret rotation
content: Rotate a credential by issuing the new secret, deploying readers that accept both versions, switching writers, verifying usage, and only then revoking the old secret.

title: Circuit breaker states
content: A circuit breaker moves from closed to open after the failure threshold, then to half-open for bounded probes. Successful probes close it; failed probes open it again.

title: SLO error budget
content: An SLO error budget is the allowed unreliability within the measurement window. Fast budget burn pauses risky releases and triggers investigation before the monthly budget is exhausted.

title: Capacity headroom
content: Capacity planning keeps tested headroom above forecast peak demand. Measure CPU, memory, queue depth, database connections, and dependency limits rather than extrapolating from average utilization alone.

title: Incident severity
content: SEV-1 is a widespread critical outage with immediate incident command. SEV-2 is major degradation with a bounded workaround. Severity is based on user impact, not how difficult the fix appears.

title: Graceful traffic drain
content: Graceful shutdown first marks the instance unready, waits for load balancers to stop new traffic, drains in-flight requests within a deadline, and then closes dependencies.

title: MAX_RETRIES configuration
content: The environment key MAX_RETRIES controls application retry attempts and defaults to 3. Retries require a deadline, jittered exponential backoff, and an idempotent operation.

title: PromoteRelease API
content: func PromoteRelease(ctx context.Context, releaseID string, expectedVersion int64) error acquires the promotion lease, checks the expected version, and atomically marks the verified release active.
